# NOAA Enterprise GitHub disclaimer

## Phylogenetic structural equation models

Package *phylosem* combines features from structural equation models
(SEM), phylogenetic comparative methods (PCM), and generalized linear
mixed models (GLMM). By doing so, it incorporates a broad feature-set:

- Comparing multiple evolutionary models similar to *phylopath*
- Estimating trade-offs among multiple traits similar to *phylolm*
- Predicting missing trait values (and associated standard errors)
  similar to *Rphylopars*
- Estimating tradeoffs including recursive (cyclic) dependencies similar
  to package *sem*
- Applying ordination to multiple traits, similar to phylogenetic factor
  analysis in package *FishLife*

*phylosem* is specifically intended as a minimal implementation, and
uses standard packages for input/output formatting:

- Input: phylogenetic relatedness defined using class *phylo* in package
  *ape*
- Input: structural trade-offs specified using syntax defined by package
  *sem*
- Output: visualizing trade-offs using *semPlot*, *diagrammeR*, and
  *ggraph*
- Output: assembling trait predictions and standard errors using
  *phylobase*
- Output: plotting trait predictions using *phylosignal*

Please see package vignettes for more details regarding syntax and
features.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Mlifehist_ver1_0`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/Mlifehist_ver1_0.md)
  : Fisheries natural mortality example
- [`as_fitted_DAG()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/as_fitted_DAG.md)
  : Convert phylosem to phylopath output
- [`as_phylo4d()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/as_phylo4d.md)
  : Convert phylosem to phylo4d
- [`as_sem()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/as_sem.md)
  : Convert phylosem to sem output
- [`average()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/average.md)
  : Choose model
- [`average(`*`<compare_phylosem>`*`)`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/average.compare_phylosem.md)
  : Choose model
- [`best()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/best.md)
  : Extract best fitted model
- [`best(`*`<compare_phylosem>`*`)`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/best.compare_phylosem.md)
  : Extract best fitted model
- [`choice()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/choice.md)
  : Choose model
- [`choice(`*`<compare_phylosem>`*`)`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/choice.compare_phylosem.md)
  : Choose model
- [`coef(`*`<phylosem>`*`)`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/coef.phylosem.md)
  : Extract path coefficients
- [`compare_phylosem()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/compare_phylosem.md)
  : Compare phylogenetic structural equation models
- [`list_parameters()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/list_parameters.md)
  : List fixed and random effects
- [`parse_path()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/parse_path.md)
  : Parse path
- [`phylosem()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/phylosem.md)
  : Fit phylogenetic structural equation model
- [`phylosem_control()`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/phylosem_control.md)
  : Detailed control for phylosem structure
- [`print(`*`<phylosem>`*`)`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/print.phylosem.md)
  : Print parameter estimates and standard errors.
- [`summary(`*`<phylosem>`*`)`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/summary.phylosem.md)
  : summarize phylosem
- [`vcov(`*`<phylosem>`*`)`](https://james-thorson-noaa.github.io/phylosem/reference/vcov.phylosem.md)
  : Extract Variance-Covariance Matrix
